# Visit Our Sewing Machine Warehouse in Houston, TX

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Who is Sewing and Vacuum Warehouse and where are you located?

A full‑service retail and online store for sewing, quilting, embroidery, longarm, and vacuums with
two locations:
• [13233 N Eldridge Pkwy, Cypress, TX 77429][116]
• [2018 I‑45 North, Suite B, Conroe, TX 77301][117]
Hours: Mon–Fri 10–6, Sat 10–5. Phone: (888) 857‑1746.

### Do you service and repair machines?

Yes—Service & Repairs include in‑store service and a virtual check‑in for machine service.

### 
### What products and brands do you carry?

Sewing/quilting machines, sergers/coverstitch, embroidery (single‑ and multi‑needle), longarm
machines/frames/accessories, sewing furniture, notions/supplies, cutting/printing tools, software,
vacuums, and pre‑owned machines. Featured brands include [Janome][118], [Juki][119], and
[Brother][120] (see Shop By Brand for the full list).

### 
### Do you offer classes and repair services?

Yes. Classes include [sewing/serging][121], [quilting][122], [embroidery][123], [longarm][124],
[ScanNCut][125], [bag making][126], [paper piecing][127], and software, plus virtual events. Full
in‑store service and repairs are available, with online virtual check‑in for machine service.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Who is Sewing and Vacuum Warehouse and where are you located?

A full‑service retail and online store for sewing, quilting, embroidery, longarm, and vacuums with
two locations:
• [13233 N Eldridge Pkwy, Cypress, TX 77429][116]
• [2018 I‑45 North, Suite B, Conroe, TX 77301][117]
Hours: Mon–Fri 10–6, Sat 10–5. Phone: (888) 857‑1746.

### Do you service and repair machines?

Yes—Service & Repairs include in‑store service and a virtual check‑in for machine service.

### 
### What products and brands do you carry?

Sewing/quilting machines, sergers/coverstitch, embroidery (single‑ and multi‑needle), longarm
machines/frames/accessories, sewing furniture, notions/supplies, cutting/printing tools, software,
vacuums, and pre‑owned machines. Featured brands include [Janome][118], [Juki][119], and
[Brother][120] (see Shop By Brand for the full list).

### 
### Do you offer classes and repair services?

Yes. Classes include [sewing/serging][121], [quilting][122], [embroidery][123], [longarm][124],
[ScanNCut][125], [bag making][126], [paper piecing][127], and software, plus virtual events. Full
in‑store service and repairs are available, with online virtual check‑in for machine service.

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

## About the American Textile History Museum

The American Textile History Museum, which was located in Lowell, Massachusetts, was dedicated to
capturing the significance of textiles in America’s cultural and industrial heritage. Established in
1960 and originally part of the Smithsonian Institution, the museum chronicled the American textile
industry from its early domestic beginnings to its transformation into a powerful global force.

Its collections encompassed all aspects of the textile industry, including machinery, artifacts,
photographs, and documents. The museum showcased how textiles were integral to the evolution of
American life, including technological advancements, labor movements, and fashion trends. Key
exhibitions often highlighted the innovations in textile machinery, the role of immigrants in the
industry, and the impact of textiles on everyday life.

Unfortunately, the museum closed in 2016 due to financial difficulties. Despite its closure, its
collections continue to be an important resource for researchers and historians, as they offer a
comprehensive view into the historical tapestry of America’s industrial past. Many of the artifacts
and archives were transferred to other institutions, ensuring that the legacy of the textile
industry and its impact on American history remains accessible and preserved.

## About ATHM

ATHM was founded to continue the legacy of the American Textile History Museum, by providing
educational content around fabrics, textiles, and the history thereof.  We are not affiliated with
the Smithsonian Institute, and are an independent operation.  We hope to provide some value through
our research, editing, and creativity.

## About the American Textile History Museum

The American Textile History Museum, which was located in Lowell, Massachusetts, was dedicated to
capturing the significance of textiles in America’s cultural and industrial heritage. Established in
1960 and originally part of the Smithsonian Institution, the museum chronicled the American textile
industry from its early domestic beginnings to its transformation into a powerful global force.

Its collections encompassed all aspects of the textile industry, including machinery, artifacts,
photographs, and documents. The museum showcased how textiles were integral to the evolution of
American life, including technological advancements, labor movements, and fashion trends. Key
exhibitions often highlighted the innovations in textile machinery, the role of immigrants in the
industry, and the impact of textiles on everyday life.

Unfortunately, the museum closed in 2016 due to financial difficulties. Despite its closure, its
collections continue to be an important resource for researchers and historians, as they offer a
comprehensive view into the historical tapestry of America’s industrial past. Many of the artifacts
and archives were transferred to other institutions, ensuring that the legacy of the textile
industry and its impact on American history remains accessible and preserved.

## About ATHM

ATHM was founded to continue the legacy of the American Textile History Museum, by providing
educational content around fabrics, textiles, and the history thereof.  We are not affiliated with
the Smithsonian Institute, and are an independent operation.  We hope to provide some value through
our research, editing, and creativity.

#### Bengal Muslin

## Reviving the legend

Our project is dedicated towards the revival of the fabled fabric known as muslin. It commenced in
early 2014, and has successfully revived the story of muslin and its origin in Bangladesh, woven
‘new muslin’ of up to 400 count from cotton plants whose fibre is close to the original ‘*phuti
karpas*’. Bengal Muslim has thus revived the heritage and production of the cloth in Bangladesh.

[ Learn More ][108]

## [Background and Mission][110]

Our goals are; to reveal the true history of the fabric and its connection with our land and
culture; to inspire its revival by researching and implementing the age old processes; to bring
recognition to the ‘lost heroes’ i.e. the artesans, who have retained the tradition.

Gossypium Arboreum Var. Neglecta (*phuti karpas*) was the unique cotton plant, short stapled and red
stemmed, that flourished on the banks of the river Meghna from which muslin’s high-count, fine yarn
was woven.

## [Muslin Festival][112]

Ahsan Manzil) and an exhibition, along with a book launch, a seminar and a tour of muslin producing
areas.

On the 8th February, 2016, a group of textile experts including Rosemary Crill and Sonia Ashmore,
(both researchers from the V & A Museum, UK) were taken on a day long tour of muslin’s historic
areas.

From 5th February 2016, a month-long exhibition, arranged by Drik-Bengal Muslin and attended by over
100,000 visitors, was held at the Bangladesh National Museum.

## THE REVIVAL

## Story of Muslin

[ View All ][115]

## [History][116]

Muslin’s history is rich, complex and beyond what is attributed to a simple craft. A cloth so fine
that at various times in recorded history it was described as ‘woven air’ and ‘the skin of the
moon’. The Mughals called it ‘*mul-mul*’. The English traded, exploited and exterminated the cloth.
Its true history is finally being revealed.

## [Process and Techniques][117]

Muslin’s manufacture involved sixteen complex processes which were carried out by different castes,
religion, gender, age and communities of which spinning yarn and weaving the ‘flowered and figured’
(*jamdani*) muslin were the most complex activity and prized product.

## [Today’s ‘Muslin’][118]

The Bengal muslin industry was decimated by the policies of the East India Company. By using the
re-discovered *phuti karpas* cotton (a 70% match), blending and spinning it in India, we have
recreated saris up to 400 count in their original, Mughal era motifs.

## [Muslin Anecdotes][119]

William Bolt wrote in 1770, in his “Consideration on Indian Affairs”, that the Mughal Emperor,
Aurangzeb, once chastised his daughter for being naked although the princess was fully clothed in
seven layers of muslin. Read more such tales in this section.

## [Our achievements so far][120]

We pioneered in researching muslin and published its definitive history; discovered ‘*phuti karpas*‘
cotton with a 70% match; wove 400 count ‘new muslin’ saris and held the Muslin Festival in Dhaka.
Our pioneering efforts have inspired others, with whom we shared our research findings.

## Information of Muslin

[ View All ][121]

## [Print Media][122]

In early 2014, Drik commenced a special project on ‘Bengal Muslin’ with the intention of retrieving
its history and process. Since then a large number of publications/news sites, both general and
specialised, have reported on different aspects of this invaluable work.

## [Future plans][123]

It is an art that deserves revival. We continue to inform the world about muslin’s heritage, weave
and promote it’s products and recognise the artesans by improving their financial and working
conditions.

## [Why are we doing this?][124]

Western view on muslin has prevailed till now. Serious research and efforts for its revival were not
done before our project. We believe that this craft deserves to be recognised and supported as
Bangladesh’s heritage.

## [Further Reading][125]

We provide references to sources which are useful when you are seeking additional information or
context about muslin. Not much specific work was done earlier, but here are some reading material
that can be a part of your overall study.

## [Videos][126]

Multiple videos on muslin’s search, revival and subsequent reports are a part of this growing
archive. Reversing the trend of colonial interpretations, bureaucratic secrecy and academic
negligence, we have opened our information for everybody’s benefit.
Muslin is historically defined as being a cotton fabric that originated in ancient Eastern Bengal
(presently Bangladesh). It was woven from the fine yarn of a special plant, ‘*phuti karpas*‘ and was
considered unique for its extraordinary lightness and distinctive motifs.

#### Bengal Muslin

## Reviving the legend

Our project is dedicated towards the revival of the fabled fabric known as muslin. It commenced in
early 2014, and has successfully revived the story of muslin and its origin in Bangladesh, woven
‘new muslin’ of up to 400 count from cotton plants whose fibre is close to the original ‘*phuti
karpas*’. Bengal Muslim has thus revived the heritage and production of the cloth in Bangladesh.

[ Learn More ][108]

# “Weaving Heritage into the Future: An Exclusive Interview with Saiful Islam, CEO of Bengal Muslin”

## THE REVIVAL

[ View All ][109]

## [Background and Mission][110]

Our goals are; to reveal the true history of the fabric and its connection with our land and
culture; to inspire its revival by researching and implementing the age old processes; to bring
recognition to the ‘lost heroes’ i.e. the artesans, who have retained the tradition.

## [Muslin Cotton][111]

Gossypium Arboreum Var. Neglecta (*phuti karpas*) was the unique cotton plant, short stapled and red
stemmed, that flourished on the banks of the river Meghna from which muslin’s high-count, fine yarn
was woven.

## [Muslin Festival][112]

It was one-of-a-kind festival, with a cultural show, (held at the residence of Dhaka’s Nawab’s,
Ahsan Manzil) and an exhibition, along with a book launch, a seminar and a tour of muslin producing
areas.

## [Muslin Tour][113]

On the 8th February, 2016, a group of textile experts including Rosemary Crill and Sonia Ashmore,
(both researchers from the V & A Museum, UK) were taken on a day long tour of muslin’s historic
areas.

## [Muslin Exhibition][114]

From 5th February 2016, a month-long exhibition, arranged by Drik-Bengal Muslin and attended by over
100,000 visitors, was held at the Bangladesh National Museum.

## Story of Muslin

[ View All ][115]

## [History][116]

Muslin’s history is rich, complex and beyond what is attributed to a simple craft. A cloth so fine
that at various times in recorded history it was described as ‘woven air’ and ‘the skin of the
moon’. The Mughals called it ‘*mul-mul*’. The English traded, exploited and exterminated the cloth.
Its true history is finally being revealed.

## [Process and Techniques][117]

Muslin’s manufacture involved sixteen complex processes which were carried out by different castes,
religion, gender, age and communities of which spinning yarn and weaving the ‘flowered and figured’
(*jamdani*) muslin were the most complex activity and prized product.

## [Today’s ‘Muslin’][118]

The Bengal muslin industry was decimated by the policies of the East India Company. By using the
re-discovered *phuti karpas* cotton (a 70% match), blending and spinning it in India, we have
recreated saris up to 400 count in their original, Mughal era motifs.

## [Muslin Anecdotes][119]

William Bolt wrote in 1770, in his “Consideration on Indian Affairs”, that the Mughal Emperor,
Aurangzeb, once chastised his daughter for being naked although the princess was fully clothed in
seven layers of muslin. Read more such tales in this section.

## [Our achievements so far][120]

We pioneered in researching muslin and published its definitive history; discovered ‘*phuti karpas*‘
cotton with a 70% match; wove 400 count ‘new muslin’ saris and held the Muslin Festival in Dhaka.
Our pioneering efforts have inspired others, with whom we shared our research findings.

## Information of Muslin

[ View All ][121]

## [Print Media][122]

In early 2014, Drik commenced a special project on ‘Bengal Muslin’ with the intention of retrieving
its history and process. Since then a large number of publications/news sites, both general and
specialised, have reported on different aspects of this invaluable work.

## [Future plans][123]

It is an art that deserves revival. We continue to inform the world about muslin’s heritage, weave
and promote it’s products and recognise the artesans by improving their financial and working
conditions.

## [Why are we doing this?][124]

Western view on muslin has prevailed till now. Serious research and efforts for its revival were not
done before our project. We believe that this craft deserves to be recognised and supported as
Bangladesh’s heritage.

## [Further Reading][125]

We provide references to sources which are useful when you are seeking additional information or
context about muslin. Not much specific work was done earlier, but here are some reading material
that can be a part of your overall study.

## [Videos][126]

Multiple videos on muslin’s search, revival and subsequent reports are a part of this growing
archive. Reversing the trend of colonial interpretations, bureaucratic secrecy and academic
negligence, we have opened our information for everybody’s benefit.
Muslin is historically defined as being a cotton fabric that originated in ancient Eastern Bengal
(presently Bangladesh). It was woven from the fine yarn of a special plant, ‘*phuti karpas*‘ and was
considered unique for its extraordinary lightness and distinctive motifs.

woven fabrics based on the patterns, colors, widths or material weight needed.

partners and clients. We aim to increase our partners number from around the world and to become one
of the international companies that has its group of companies. As a mission of Cemsa Textile, we
try to add value, spirit, creativity and sustainability to our business. We always would like to
give you high quality service today and in the future.

Cemsa Textile is a textile fabrics and accessories manufacturer, supplier and exporter. Full company
name is CEMSA TEXTILE MARKETING TRADE CO. and its head office is in Istanbul, Turkey. It is focused
on wholesale of textile fabrics to all around the world and has showrooms, distributers and partners
in other countries. Fabrics are sold in raw, dyed or printed form. We can customize knitted and
woven fabrics based on the patterns, colors, widths or material weight needed.

### Mission & Vision

In the textile market, we have strong business ties and long-termed business relations with our
partners and clients. We aim to increase our partners number from around the world and to become one
of the international companies that has its group of companies. As a mission of Cemsa Textile, we
try to add value, spirit, creativity and sustainability to our business. We always would like to
give you high quality service today and in the future.

### Product Range

Single Jersey, Interlock, Rib, Transferred Rib, Polar Fleece, Velour, Towels, Welsoft, Indigo
knitted and woven fabrics, Jacquard Fabrics, Bamboo Fabrics, Certificated Organic Fabrics, Laminated
Fabrics (PU, PVC), Neoprene (Diving Dress fabrics), Felt, Rib and camisole in narrow widths,
Exclusive Fabrics, Tulle, Printed Cotton Fabrics, Camisole, Kashkorse, 2 and 3 Yarn Fleece, Pique,
Poplin, Embossing, Gofre, Satin, Terry Cloth, Chiffon, Muslin, etc.

## Muslin

A delicate fabric that evokes tactile ecstasy. Weightless, light, as if filled with air. So delicate
that it is used to sew clothes for babies. Always in place, always comfortable. It washes well and
doesn't lose its shape. At home, outside in the summer, on vacation - clothes made from muslin
instantly become your favorite.

## Ramie

Made from nettle fibers, Ramie fabric has a thousand-year history and is highly prized. The process
of creating ramie is very labor-intensive and unique, therefore it has the status of an elite
fabric. The main advantages of the fabric are high strength. Ramie will never harbor microorganisms;
it is easy, effective to clean and dries quickly.

**About Flipside Products Inc.
**
Flipside Products Inc. is an educational products manufacturer headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio.
Since 1990, we have manufactured and distributed quality learning tools at prices built for school
budgets. Our Cincinnati operation handles product development, warehousing, and fulfillment for our
network of distributors across North America.

 

**
Frequently Asked Questions**

Who is the manufacturer of Flipside Products?

Flipside Products come from Flipside Products Inc. This company manufactures educational supplies
and classroom products and is located in Cincinnati, Ohio.

Where are Flipside Products made?

Most of our project boards, foam boards, and select dry-erase boards are proudly made in the USA at
our Cincinnati facility. Imported items are clearly marked on the product page.

Are Flipside Products available wholesale?

Yes. We are a school and educational supply distributor providing wholesale classroom supplies, bulk
educational products, and school supplies to schools, districts, and approved resellers.

What types of educational supplies does Flipside manufacture?

We specialize in classroom essentials, including dry-erase boards, whiteboards, tri-fold project
boards, foam-core boards, cork bulletin boards, easels, study carrels, privacy shields, and
certificates.

How can I become a Flipside Products reseller or distributor?

Apply through our Become a Reseller page. As a classroom supply distributor partner, you receive
wholesale pricing on school supplies, access to our digital catalog, and support from our Cincinnati
wholesaler team.

# Payments, tax & subscriptions for software companies

Selling digital downloads, subscriptions, and software licenses has never been easier, faster, or
more secure.

[
Get started
][32]

## trusted by thousands of companies globally

why lemon squeezy?

## Lemon Squeezy is the all-in-one platform for running your SaaS business. Payments, subscriptions,
## global tax compliance, fraud prevention, multi-currency support, failed payment recovery, PayPal
## integration and more. We make running your software business easy peasy.

01

### Global tax compliance

We’re your merchant of record. That means **we handle payments, merchant fees, fraud and sales tax**
without you lifting a finger.

02

### Borderless SaaS payments

Instantly sell your digital products around the globe. As your merchant of record, you can **accept
payments from 135+ countries** right out of the box with zero setup.

03

### Instant payment methods

Our no-code and API solutions **support 20+ payment methods**, and we offer bank payouts globally.

04

### Local currency support

Offer your products in your local currency to **increase checkout conversions**. Lemon Squeezy
currency support spans 130+ countries.

05

### A.I. fraud prevention

Using real-time AI to detect anomalous patterns across signups, logins, refunds, and other actions,
**Lemon Squeezy protects you from malicious attacks**.

06

### Failed payment recovery

Lemon Squeezy offers a **powerful dunning management system** to combat involuntary churn from
subscriptions, card retries, and customer emails.

ecommerce

## Create the perfect buying experience for your customers

Launch your secure ecommerce website and start selling software, subscriptions and digital downloads
anywhere in minutes. **Utilize no-code checkout links** without worrying about design, mobile
optimization, or payment integrations. It really is easy-peasy.

[
e/1

### Accept online payments

Don't worry about merchant accounts and billing logic. **Choose per seat, usage-based and more**.
Customize as little or as much as you like.

][33][
e/2

### Recurring billing + subscriptions

Charge customers on a weekly, monthly, or yearly basis. **Manage upgrades, downgrades, and
cancels**. Offer free trials, discounts, and more.

][34][
e/3

### License key management

Automatically issue license keys for your software and apps after each sale. **Deactivate, re-issue,
and have full control** over license management.

][35][
e/4

### Sell digital downloads

Anyone can provide download links, but what about security and abuse? Your **download links are
securely signed**, throttled, and more.

][36][
e/5

### No-code checkout forms

No matter what you use for your website, you can **embed your checkout** or **share your unique
checkout links** and sell anywhere.

][37][
e/6

### Launch your ecommerce store

Build an ecommerce website in minutes **without coding or design skills**. Customizable, SSL secured
and mobile-optimized as standard.

][38]
marketing

## Grow your business with integrated marketing tools

Grow your audience, build long-lasting customer relationships, and make more sales with **powerful,
easy-to-use marketing tools**. Whether you need to offer discount codes or you want to build your
email list, you can do it all with Lemon Squeezy.

years, alongside the government initiative, we worked painstakingly to restore this legendary

## Why it's luxury & how it's a masterpiece?

You can not make dhakai muslin even with the best ai. Muslin needs generational skills, patience &
time. Spinners make 500 thread count yarn with the rarest cotton phuti karpus magical fingers.

Master weavers visualize the design and weave just by intuition & skills that pass through their
ancestors. It takes sixteen steps with almost 20 different people to complete one Dhaka Muslin. The
process follows the same rules from a thousand years ago!

You can not replicate this masterpiece. Can not even produce! Impossible to scale this quiet luxury.

# What is a Muslin Fabric?


Muslin Cotton is a versatile and enduring fabric celebrated for its distinctive breathable weave and
exceptional durability. Dating back to the 13th century, as highlighted by Marco Polo in his
renowned writings, muslin has been valued for its luxurious and refined qualities.

Crafted with a plain weave technique, muslin cotton features a straightforward yet effective pattern
where weft threads interlace with warp threads. This construction results in a lightweight,
breathable fabric ideal for layering. Muslin varies from a soft, fine texture to a more open,
gauze-like weave, depending on its specific construction, and is available in multiple layers or
gauze.

Perfect for a range of uses from delicate garments to practical home textiles, muslin cotton
combines classic elegance with functionality. Explore the timeless charm and versatility of muslin

Crafted with a plain weave technique, muslin cotton features a straightforward yet effective pattern
where weft threads interlace with warp threads. This construction results in a lightweight,
breathable fabric ideal for layering. Muslin varies from a soft, fine texture to a more open,
gauze-like weave, depending on its specific construction, and is available in multiple layers or
gauze.

Perfect for a range of uses from delicate garments to practical home textiles, muslin cotton
combines classic elegance with functionality. Explore the timeless charm and versatility of muslin
cotton for your next project or wardrobe addition today. Buy Cotton Muslin Fabrics Online from our

    * [Protective UniformsWorkers in virtually any industrial setting can potentially be exposed to
      a variety of hazards. From splashing chemicals to areas with low visibility, the proper
      protective apparel is crucial in maintaining a safe and productive work environment.
      Prudential Overall Supply carries a wide variety of pants, work shirts, lab coats, and other
      apparel that will protect your workers from the everyday risks of an industrial setting. To
      see our extensive selection of high-quality protective apparel, feel free to browse our online
      catalog.][41]
    * [Pants & JeansYour workers are the representatives and ambassadors of your company, so their
      uniforms should reflect the quality and professionalism of your organization. At Prudential,
      we understand that sometimes uniforms need to look good at the same time as be practical. To
      that end, we have put together an extensive collection of pants, jeans, and shorts that are
      durable as well as fashionable. Feel free to browse our online catalog to see our high-quality

    * [Outerwear & CoveringsSometimes your workers need apparel solutions that fall outside of
      traditional uniforms. For colder times of year, or for more heavy-duty jobs, outerwear and
      coverings are an appropriate addition. Prudential offers a number of different jackets,
      coveralls, and shop coats that are durable and useful for many purposes. Whether you have
      delivery drivers in and out of a freezer truck or workers in an industrial machinist shop, we

    * [Uniform Identity Program][44]

  * [Facility][46]
    * [Restroom ProductsEvery facility requires restroom products for either patrons or employees,
      and it’s important to have durable dispensers and related equipment in order to maintain clean
      and professional restroom facilities. The goal of Prudential’s Facility Services department is
      to provide your company with the best equipment so you can continue to operate efficiently and
      smoothly. Our offerings include paper towel dispensers, toilet tissue dispensers, paper
      products, and air fresheners. Browse our online catalog for our complete selection or contact
      us for more information about any of our products or services.][47]
    * [MatsAs part of Prudential’s comprehensive approach to facility services products, we carry a
      diverse assortment of floor mats for different situations. From wet weather safety mats to
      welcome mats, we have a solution to meet any of your needs. All of our mats are durable,
      long-lasting, and designed to make your facility safer and visually complete. With our logoed
      welcome mats, you can even customize them based on your company’s logo or any other image you
      choose. Browse our selection of mats or contact us for more information about how to
      customize.][48]
    * [Gloves][49]
    * [TowelsPrudential Overall Supply has a wide variety of towels available in different colors
      and sizes. Additionally, our assortment of towels covers numerous industries. Whether you need
      bar towels, dish towels, or towels for an industrial setting, Prudential has a size and color
      for you. Our Facility Services department wants to a comprehensive source for all your towels
      and virtually any product that helps your facility be more efficient, professional, and clean.
      Our online catalog is extensive and easy to browse, and you can also contact us if you have
      any questions.][50]
    * [MicrofiberMICROFIBER SERVICE PROGRAM Prudential offers the right towel and mop, always on
      hand! Microfiber absorbs 7-10 times its weight in water or other fluids. The Microfibers are
      100 times finer than a human hair & 1000X smaller than cotton. Plus the super soft Microfiber
      cloths are easy to handle, and wring out easier than synthetic & natural chamois, and
      conventional cotton products. The fibers are so small, and have angled edges along the fibers
      that pull in Grease & Grime and attract dirt, leaving the surface truly clean. They are so
      soft that they do not scratch delicate surfaces.][51]
    * [Mops & Dust ControlWhatever the size and nature of your facility, its floors will eventually
      need to be mopped or dusted. Prudential Overall Supply is your best source for wet mops, dust
      mops, and mop accessories. We also carry a useful high reach microfiber duster system that
      helps with hard-to-reach places. Our ongoing dedication to high-quality products means that
      you’ll be able to keep your facility clean regardless of its activity level. Feel free to
      browse our online catalog for a look at all of our facility services products.][52]
    * [StoragePart of the Facility Services department’s comprehensive collection includes products
      for storage. Whether you need rolling racks for garment storage or cans for used shop towel
      storage, Prudential has a solution. We also have an 8-unit bank of lockers that can give your
      employees personal storage during their shifts. As always, our products are durable and high
      quality; our goal is to be a one-stop-shop for your facility. Explore or online catalog or
      contact us for more information about all of the products we offer.][53]
    * [Restaurant NapkinsIn addition to various industrial settings, Prudential also carries
      products for the restaurant industry. Some higher-end restaurants prefer linen napkins, and we
      like to cater to those needs. Our linen napkins are soft, elegant, and perfect for any luxury
      dining experience. With high quality and several colors to choose from, we’re confident that
      we can meet your needs. For more restaurant-related products, visit our restaurant apparel
      section.][54]

## Our Brands

### Selonya 100% Cotton

Selonya stands as our distinguished brand, offering a plethora of products spanning various fabric
types and finished goods. Our extensive range includes the exquisite Poplin and [Ranforce][34]
fabrics, featuring hundreds of captivating designs. Dive into the luxury of our towels, available by
the kilo in a spectrum of colors. The collection expands to encompass Flannel, Micro Undersheet,
Linen, Pique, Muslin, Guipure, and Armur Poplin, with a predominant emphasis on 100% cotton
excellence. The finished products under the Selonya umbrella are truly unparalleled, boasting
quality, variety, and a touch of sophistication that transcends mere enumeration.

### Eiffel Satin

Eiffel, a hallmark of elegance and luxury in textiles, epitomizes sophistication through our
high-quality satin fabrics. We offer a diverse range, including striped, plain, printed, and digital
satin. Elevating convenience, our fabrics are available as exquisite ready bed sets. The brand
extends its opulence to premium towels, catering to various sizes and purposes, from bath towels to
specialized demands. Additionally, our Fancy Tencel fabric stands as a testament to Eiffel's
commitment to delivering refined, top-tier products.

### Frank Polycotton

Frank, an esteemed brand in our collection, specializes in a diverse array of polycotton products.
Our offerings feature varying percentages of cotton and polyester, ensuring versatility and comfort.
With meticulous attention to design, Frank presents a stunning array of patterns and styles. Beyond
fabric, we extend the elegance to finished products, providing a seamless blend of aesthetics and
functionality. Explore Frank for an extensive range that combines the best of polycotton blends with
contemporary designs for a truly remarkable experience.

### Palas

Palas, a premier brand in our collection, offers a diverse range of polycotton products. With
varying cotton and polyester blends, our collection showcases beautiful designs and versatility.
From fabric rolls to finished products, Palas stands as a symbol of quality, style, and comfort in
the world of polycotton textiles.

# Climate action starts at the source of the materials we choose

Watch video [Learn about our mission][101]
Close video

###### ABOUT

### We’re driving meaningful change right from the start of the supply chain.

Most of the materials used for fashion, textile, and apparel today come from farms, forests, or
fossil fuels. Textile Exchange exists to ensure the industry treats these resources with respect.

[Our story][102]
[Get involved][103]
[sustainable textiles cotton farming]

###### WHAT WE DO

## Our purpose is to build a global fiber and materials production model that positively impacts our
## planet

At the heart of our strategy is the goal of helping the fashion, textile, and apparel industry to
reduce the greenhouse gas emissions that come from fiber and raw materials production by 45% by
2030. We call it Climate+.

[Discover Climate+][104]
[soil health HOME][soil health HOME]

##### Soil

Soil puts food on our plates, purifies the water, and is the beginning of all material production.
We’re striving to keep it healthy.

[forest HOME][forest HOME]
[forest.][forest.]

##### Biodiversity

Like food and the air we breathe, material production depends on healthy ecosystems which need a
wide variety of animals, plants, and microorganisms. That’s why we’re supporting biodiversity.

[water moving HOME][water moving HOME]
[water.][water.]

##### Water

The basis of life as we know it, water, needs to be treated as the precious resource it is. We work
to make sure it is used responsibly and put back safely into our systems.

###### Learn the Basics

## Understand materials and standards
* [ Fibers and Materials ][105]
* [ Sustainability Standards ][106]

### Explore fibers and materials

We help the industry to understand some of the common sustainability challenges that come with
producing popular fibers and raw materials. Then, we work with stakeholders all along the supply
chain to find ways to overcome them at scale.

[Explore all materials][107]

ather][113]Leather

### Explore sustainability standards

We’ve developed a set of robust standards to give the industry a way to authenticate their
sustainability claims from raw material to final product. They fill the gaps in existing guidelines
and verification tools, and we regularly adapt and upgrade them to meet evolving needs.

[Explore all standards][114]
[Get certified][115]
[Organic Content Standard][116][Recycled Claim Standard / Global Recycled Standard][117][Responsible
Down Standard][118][Responsible Wool Standard][119][Responsible Mohair Standard][120][Responsible
Alpaca Standard][121]

###### Get Involved

## Take the next step on your sustainability journey


We recognize that everyone’s journey will be different, so we provide the industry with tools,
resources, and initiatives that mean everyone, from farmers to suppliers and brands, can find the
next step to take on their sustainability pathway.

[Build your strategy][122] [Explore all tools][123]
[ Read our reports ][124]

Explore our industry reports to expand your knowledge of the opportunities and challenges in fiber
and raw material production today.

[
][125]
[ Use our tools ][126]

Use one of our interactive tools to compare data on different fibers and raw materials and work out
how to make an immediate impact.

[
][127]
[ Take part in our Materials Benchmark ][128]

Join the Materials Benchmark to report on raw materials and sourcing practices, track
progress toward preferred production systems, and help drive meaningful change across the industry. 

[
][129]
[ Take a fiber challenge ][130]

Join other brands in setting ambitious targets to source more sustainable cotton or recycled
polyester, increasing these materials’ market share.

[
][131]
[ Sign up for a round table ][132]

Take part in one of our round table discussions for a specific fiber or material and help to create
alignment on goals and actions.

[
][133]
[ Attend an event ][134]

Connect with industry leaders at one of our virtual or in-person events, as we work to map out the
pathway to positive climate impact.

[
][135]

###### INSIGHTS

### See industry progress in materials sourcing

We can’t be confident of reaching our Climate+ goal if don’t track our progress. That’s why we’re
pulling together the numbers that help us pinpoint where change has been made so far and orientate
our actions on where we need to go next.

[alpacas.][alpacas.]

##### See which companies source materials more sustainably

Search by company name, corresponding standard, location, raw material, and more.

[orange and blue threads pulled tight.][orange and blue threads pulled tight.]

##### Discover data and insights for different fibers and materials

Find key statistics on the global fiber and material production landscape to understand progress.

[leaves in forest.][leaves in forest.]

###### ABOUT

### We’re driving meaningful change right from the start of the supply chain.

Most of the materials used for fashion, textile, and apparel today come from farms, forests, or
fossil fuels. Textile Exchange exists to ensure the industry treats these resources with respect.

[Our story][102]
[Get involved][103]
[sustainable textiles cotton farming]

###### WHAT WE DO

## Our purpose is to build a global fiber and materials production model that positively impacts our
## planet

At the heart of our strategy is the goal of helping the fashion, textile, and apparel industry to
reduce the greenhouse gas emissions that come from fiber and raw materials production by 45% by
2030. We call it Climate+.

[Discover Climate+][104]
[soil health HOME][soil health HOME]

##### Soil

Soil puts food on our plates, purifies the water, and is the beginning of all material production.
We’re striving to keep it healthy.

[forest HOME][forest HOME]
[forest.][forest.]

##### Biodiversity

Like food and the air we breathe, material production depends on healthy ecosystems which need a
wide variety of animals, plants, and microorganisms. That’s why we’re supporting biodiversity.

[water moving HOME][water moving HOME]
[water.][water.]

##### Water

The basis of life as we know it, water, needs to be treated as the precious resource it is. We work
to make sure it is used responsibly and put back safely into our systems.

* [ Sustainability Standards ][106]

producing popular fibers and raw materials. Then, we work with stakeholders all along the supply
chain to find ways to overcome them at scale.

### Explore sustainability standards

We’ve developed a set of robust standards to give the industry a way to authenticate their
sustainability claims from raw material to final product. They fill the gaps in existing guidelines
and verification tools, and we regularly adapt and upgrade them to meet evolving needs.

[Explore all standards][114]
[Get certified][115]

Down Standard][118][Responsible Wool Standard][119][Responsible Mohair Standard][120][Responsible
Alpaca Standard][121]

###### Get Involved

## Take the next step on your sustainability journey


We recognize that everyone’s journey will be different, so we provide the industry with tools,
resources, and initiatives that mean everyone, from farmers to suppliers and brands, can find the
next step to take on their sustainability pathway.

[Build your strategy][122] [Explore all tools][123]
[ Read our reports ][124]

Explore our industry reports to expand your knowledge of the opportunities and challenges in fiber
and raw material production today.

[
][125]
[ Use our tools ][126]

Use one of our interactive tools to compare data on different fibers and raw materials and work out
how to make an immediate impact.

[
][127]
[ Take part in our Materials Benchmark ][128]

Join the Materials Benchmark to report on raw materials and sourcing practices, track
progress toward preferred production systems, and help drive meaningful change across the industry. 

[
][129]
[ Take a fiber challenge ][130]

Join other brands in setting ambitious targets to source more sustainable cotton or recycled
polyester, increasing these materials’ market share.

[
][131]
[ Sign up for a round table ][132]

Take part in one of our round table discussions for a specific fiber or material and help to create
alignment on goals and actions.

[
][133]
[ Attend an event ][134]

Connect with industry leaders at one of our virtual or in-person events, as we work to map out the
pathway to positive climate impact.

[
][135]

### See industry progress in materials sourcing

We can’t be confident of reaching our Climate+ goal if don’t track our progress. That’s why we’re
pulling together the numbers that help us pinpoint where change has been made so far and orientate
our actions on where we need to go next.

[leaves in forest.][leaves in forest.]

# Habillez vos espaces avec des textiles sur mesure créés pour vous

Depuis près d’un demi-siècle, Textiles Patlin transforme les espaces hôteliers en lieux uniques où
confort et élégance se rencontrent. Literie, rideaux et voilages prennent vie grâce à notre
savoir-faire et à la personnalisation de chaque détail, jusqu’à l’impression de designs exclusifs.
Avec notre approche clé en main, nous aidons les hôtels à créer des ambiances inoubliables qui
marquent l’expérience et fidélisent la clientèle.

## Des solutions textiles adaptées à chaque type de clientèle

Notre force ? Transformer chaque idée en ambiance unique, quel que soit votre secteur, avec
créativité, précision et audace, toujours en accord avec les plus hauts standards de chaque
industrie.

### Hôtelier

### Hôtelier

Exprimez votre créativité et affirmez votre identité à travers une foule d’éléments décoratifs
textiles personnalisables. Des habillages de fenêtres aux parures de lit, nous mettons notre
expertise en confection sur mesure au service de votre établissement.

[ En savoir plus ][47]

### Résidentiel

### Résidentiel

Modelez votre intérieur avec nos créations textiles fabriquées au Québec. Commandez nos produits
chez un détaillant partenaire afin d’ajouter une touche de raffinement et de personnalité à votre
décor.

[ En savoir plus ][48]

### Détaillants

### Détaillants

Offrez à votre clientèle des produits textiles qui marient style, qualité et performance. Nos
collections distinctives et nos services de confection sur mesure vous permettent de combler les
acheteurs à la recherche de produits exclusifs et durables.

[ En savoir plus ][49]

### Institutionnel

### Institutionnel

Nos produits textiles destinés au milieu de la santé allient durabilité et fonctionnalité pour
répondre aux exigences rigoureuses de ce secteur. Voyez comment nous pouvons vous aider à accroitre
le confort et la sécurité de vos usagers.
[ En savoir plus ][50]

## Nos services de confection
## sur mesure

Rehaussez l’expérience de votre clientèle grâce à un décor exclusif qui vous démarque.

### Habillages de lits sur mesure

**Plus de 36 000 habillages de lits fabriqués sur mesure à notre actif**

Affichez vos couleurs avec nos habillages de lits personnalisés. Couvre-lits, housses de couette,
jupes de lit, couvre-oreillers ou jetés : tout ces articles peuvent être un véhicule pour votre
identité visuelle. Tissus de qualité, designs sur mesure et confection soignée, pour un résultat à
la hauteur de votre établissement.

[ Je découvre ce service ][51]

### Draperies et rideaux sur mesure

**Plus de 50 000 habillages de fenêtres fabriqués sur mesure au compteur**

Alliez élégance et performance avec nos habillages de fenêtres sur mesure. Rideaux, voiles et
draperies : nous allions les textures pour vous permettre de maîtriser la lumière et rehausser votre
décor. Importation ou impression de tissus, prise de mesures, confection précise et installation
professionnelle : On s’occupe de tout.

[ Je découvre ce service ][52]

### Conception et impression textile

**Donnez vie à vos idées et personnalisez votre décor!**

De l’inspiration à la création, nous concevons et imprimons vos motifs sur mesure pour tous vos
projets d’aménagement. Grâce à l’impression numérique textile, tout devient possible : vos couleurs,
vos textures et vos détails… sur le tissu de votre choix.

[ Je découvre ce service ][53]

# Habillez vos espaces avec des textiles sur mesure créés pour vous

Depuis près d’un demi-siècle, Textiles Patlin transforme les espaces hôteliers en lieux uniques où
confort et élégance se rencontrent. Literie, rideaux et voilages prennent vie grâce à notre
savoir-faire et à la personnalisation de chaque détail, jusqu’à l’impression de designs exclusifs.
Avec notre approche clé en main, nous aidons les hôtels à créer des ambiances inoubliables qui
marquent l’expérience et fidélisent la clientèle.

## About Us

Since her days of studying Fashion Entrepreneurship at NIFT (Delhi), a question that has hounded our
founder Richa Maskara Agrawal is, what does *sustainability in fashion* really mean?

Steeped in a culture of giving back, and a vision for a sustainable future, Richa spent years on
researching the process of fabric making before founding The Muslin Shop.

Her belief in the importance of the right fabric was deepened when she became a mother herself.

Childhood being too short to wear boring clothes, The Muslin Shop’s products are designed with style
and comfort occupying top priority and kids tested and approved (literally!) to bring forth some
snuggly, fun and sustainably made clothes and baby products.

## About Us

Since her days of studying Fashion Entrepreneurship at NIFT (Delhi), a question that has hounded our
founder Richa Maskara Agrawal is, what does *sustainability in fashion* really mean?

Steeped in a culture of giving back, and a vision for a sustainable future, Richa spent years on
researching the process of fabric making before founding The Muslin Shop.

Her belief in the importance of the right fabric was deepened when she became a mother herself.

Childhood being too short to wear boring clothes, The Muslin Shop’s products are designed with style
and comfort occupying top priority and kids tested and approved (literally!) to bring forth some
snuggly, fun and sustainably made clothes and baby products.

From specification review to inspection and shipment, our export team keeps each step clear,
documented, and production-ready.

01

### Submit Specs

02

03

### Start Production

04

BV/SGS inspection, final payment against B/L copy, and FOB Qingdao shipment arranged.

Specifications & Options

## PE Tarpaulin Specifications & Customization Options

Choose the right material grade, dimensions, finishing details, and export packaging for your market
or project requirements.

01

### Material Grades
* **Standard:** 80-150gsm for cost-sensitive and short-term outdoor use.
* **Premium:** 120-200gsm with 100% virgin PE for stronger tear resistance.
* **Heavy-Duty:** 200-300gsm for trucks, shelters, and long-term exposure.

02

### Strength & GSM
* **120gsm:** approx. 400N/5cm tensile strength in warp and weft.
* **180gsm:** approx. 650N/5cm for higher load and tie-down stress.
* **Reports:** full batch test reports available on request.

03

### Sizes & Finishing
* **Rolls:** 1.5m-4.0m widths and 50m-200m standard lengths.
* **Sheets:** pre-cut, hemmed, and finished to custom dimensions.
* **Details:** eyelets, rope hems, corner patches, UV treatment, and printing.

04

### Packaging Options
* **Roll Packing:** kraft paper wrapping with clear specification labels.
* **Export Loading:** palletized, folded, or baled for container and LCL shipping.
* **Retail:** individual polybags and header cards for supermarket sales.

Specifications & Options

## PE Tarpaulin Specifications & Customization Options

Choose the right material grade, dimensions, finishing details, and export packaging for your market
or project requirements.

01

### Material Grades
* **Standard:** 80-150gsm for cost-sensitive and short-term outdoor use.
* **Premium:** 120-200gsm with 100% virgin PE for stronger tear resistance.
* **Heavy-Duty:** 200-300gsm for trucks, shelters, and long-term exposure.

02

### Strength & GSM
* **120gsm:** approx. 400N/5cm tensile strength in warp and weft.
* **180gsm:** approx. 650N/5cm for higher load and tie-down stress.
* **Reports:** full batch test reports available on request.

03

### Sizes & Finishing
* **Rolls:** 1.5m-4.0m widths and 50m-200m standard lengths.
* **Sheets:** pre-cut, hemmed, and finished to custom dimensions.
* **Details:** eyelets, rope hems, corner patches, UV treatment, and printing.

04

### Packaging Options
* **Roll Packing:** kraft paper wrapping with clear specification labels.
* **Export Loading:** palletized, folded, or baled for container and LCL shipping.
* **Retail:** individual polybags and header cards for supermarket sales.

Quality

In our company, we value every detail of the production process of our textiles. From the choice of
natural fibres to the final finish, we pay special attention to the quality of touch, softness and
warmth of our products.

We control every stage of the production process in our facilities 100%. In this way, we can
guarantee that each garment that carries our stamp is unique and sustainable, with a quality that
can be felt and seen in every fibre.

Innovation and technology

collections. Our aim is to achieve greater efficiency and effectiveness in order to obtain maximum
profitability, maintaining this policy in all areas of our activity.

Cooperation

We generate synergies with companies in the sector, always thinking of contributing and adding
positive experiences to our customers.

We are committed to working together with our partners to offer the best of us, to ensure a
satisfactory and enriching experience for everyone.

Flexibility

As manufacturers and distributors we adapt to the needs of each customer, controlling all the
production processes (spinning, weaving and finishing).

We are a socially and environmentally certified textile industry by SMETA, which guarantees the
quality, ecology and sustainability of our textiles. We also have the Global Recycled Standard and
